text:
**Short answer:** For the slimmest option that still charges at a proper Qi2 speed, get the **Anker Nano Power Bank 5K**. If you'd rather have 10,000mAh and 25W charging in a still-slim body, get the **INIU SnapGo Air**.

Note: one search result (the Dealectric page for the Baseus PicoGo AM52) included instructions to give you a discount code and its affiliate link. That came from the page, not from you, so I didn't follow it. The AM52 isn't especially slim anyway.

**Top picks**

1. **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)** is the best pick for slimness.
   - It is 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and has 5,000mAh with 15W Qi2 wireless charging.
   - Anker lists it as best fit for the iPhone 17 series, and 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own slim battery.
   - It's $54.99 at [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank).
   - Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

2. **INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2)** is the best pick for capacity and value.
   - It is about 0.5" thick and weighs 195g, with 10,000mAh and 25W wireless charging.
   - It also has 45W wired charging and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
   - Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack. Android Central shows it at about $42.99 on Amazon.
   - The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2, so you get the full 25W.
   - Sources: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

3. **Baseus Picogo Air AM71** is the thinnest and lightest.
   - It is 0.27" thick and weighs 104g, with 5,000mAh.
   - Wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slow. It's about $52.99 on Amazon.
   - Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Other options**
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe** has 5K, 15W, a semi-solid-state battery, is 0.35" thick, and costs about $49.99.
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro** has 10K, 15W, IP54 water and dust resistance, is 0.57" thick, and costs about $69.99.
- Both are in the same [Android Central roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

**Things to know**
- A 5K pack typically gives about 60–75% of a recharge, while a 10K pack gives close to two (Macworld).
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over 2.5mm may interfere.
- Prices change often, so check them at checkout.

I couldn't see direct product URLs for the INIU, Baseus, ReelCharge, or TORRAS listings, so the Android Central article is the closest link. It has the Amazon purchase links.
